Venus is the second planet from the Sun, making a full orbit in about 224 days.

Venus orbits the Sun at an average distance of about 0.72 [AU](/wiki/Astronomical_unit "Astronomical unit") (108 million [km](/wiki/Kilometre "Kilometre"); 67 million [mi](/wiki/Mile "Mile")), and completes an orbit every 224.7 days. Although all planetary [orbits](/wiki/Orbit "Orbit") are [elliptical](/wiki/Ellipse "Ellipse"), Venus's orbit is currently the closest to circular, with an [eccentricity](/wiki/Orbital_eccentricity "Orbital eccentricity") of less than 0.01.[[6]](#cite_note-fact-6) Simulations of the early solar system orbital dynamics have shown that the eccentricity of the Venus orbit may have been substantially larger in the past, reaching values as high as 0.31 and possibly impacting early climate evolution.[[142]](#cite_note-psj_1_42-144)
